description: Fast read-only product list for ONE workspace (the user's current one unless workspace_id is given). Use instead of autowhisper_cmo when the user only wants to list/search products.

limit.description: Maximum products to return, capped by the API.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to read. Omit for the user's CURRENT workspace — other workspaces are NOT included. To reach another one, get its id from autowhisper_status.

name: autowhisper_products
title: AutoWhisper products
